name: The Creative
essence: Pure, tireless creative force, like the sky that never stops turning. This is about the power to begin and to sustain, and about knowing which stage of that power you are in.

name: The Receptive
essence: The power of the earth: to receive, carry, and bring to completion. This is about strength that works by responding, supporting, and nurturing rather than by initiating.

name: Difficult Beginnings
essence: The tangled, effortful start of something new, like a sprout pushing through hard ground. This is about getting through confusion at the beginning without forcing or giving up.

name: Youthful Folly
essence: The not-knowing of the beginner and the right relationship between learner and teacher. This is about how to learn well, how to teach well, and the price of insincere questions.

name: Waiting
essence: Waiting with confidence for what cannot be hurried, like waiting for rain. This is about using the waiting well: keeping calm, nourishing yourself, and staying ready.

name: Conflict
essence: A clash of wills where you feel you are right and are blocked. This is about how to handle disputes: stop halfway, seek a fair judge, and avoid carrying a fight to the bitter end.

name: The Army
essence: An organized force gathered under one capable leader. This is about mobilizing people for a hard task with discipline, a just cause, and seasoned leadership.

name: Holding Together
essence: People gathering around a center and holding together like water on the earth. This is about joining the right group or person, or becoming a center others can rely on, and doing so in time.

name: Small Taming
essence: A small, soft force holds back a great one for a while. Real progress is near but not yet possible, so you work by gentle influence and careful preparation rather than by force.

name: Treading Carefully
essence: You must step near something powerful and dangerous. Good manners, clear awareness of your place, and calm care let you pass without harm.

name: Peace
essence: Heaven and Earth meet and exchange: everything flows, things grow, people cooperate. It is a time of flourishing, to be used well and not taken for granted.

name: Standstill
essence: Heaven and Earth pull apart and nothing flows between them. When the wrong people hold sway, you keep your integrity, withdraw from what is corrupt, and wait for the tide to turn.

name: Fellowship
essence: People united by a shared purpose and open dealing achieve great things. Fellowship must be public and inclusive, not a closed circle of favorites.

name: Great Possession
essence: You hold much: resources, influence, talent, success. Great possession is fortunate when it is held with modesty, clarity and a sense of duty to what is good.

name: Modesty
essence: True modesty is not making yourself small but having inner substance that does not need to show off. It balances excess and lack, and it lets you carry things through to the end.

name: Enthusiasm
essence: Energy bursts from the ground like thunder in spring and moves people. Enthusiasm rightly channeled gathers others and gets things moving. Misused, it becomes self-indulgence or delusion.

name: Following
essence: Following is about choosing well whom and what you follow, and adapting to the time without losing yourself. People follow freely only someone who first knows how to follow.

name: Repairing the Spoiled
essence: Something has been spoiled through neglect, often handed down from those before you. Now is the time to face it and set it right, with thought before and after.

name: Approach
essence: Strength is rising and the good is drawing near. It is a time of hopeful growth and of meeting others warmly, while remembering that every spring turns to autumn.

name: Contemplation
essence: Contemplation means looking deeply and being looked at. You see the whole situation clearly, and your own conduct becomes an example others watch.

name: Biting Through
essence: Something is stuck between you and your goal, and it must be bitten through firmly. Clear judgment and real consequences restore order.

name: Grace
essence: Grace is beauty and form: the elegance that makes life pleasant and ordered. It brings success in small things, but it is ornament, not substance.

name: Splitting Apart
essence: Splitting Apart is a time of decline, when the weak undermine the strong from below. Do not act against it. Hold still, be generous, and protect the seed of what is good.

name: Return
essence: After the darkest point, the light comes back. Return is the turning of the cycle and the recovery of your true path, a new beginning to be nurtured gently.

name: Innocence
essence: Act from what is genuinely right rather than from calculation or design. When your intentions are clean, things go well. When you scheme or force, even good aims turn against you.

name: Great Taming
essence: Great energy is being held, gathered and trained rather than spent. Restraint now builds a reserve of strength, knowledge and character that you will later use for something large.

name: Nourishment
essence: Pay attention to what feeds you and how you feed others. Body, mind and character are all shaped by what you take in and what you give out.

name: Great Exceeding
essence: Too much weight rests on too weak a structure, and the situation is near the breaking point. It calls for extraordinary action, taken with care, and the courage to stand alone if necessary.

name: The Abyss
essence: You are in danger upon danger, like water in a ravine. The way through is to keep your heart sincere and to move as water does: steadily, without losing its nature.

name: The Clinging
essence: Fire gives light only by clinging to something that burns. Clarity and brightness depend on what you attach yourself to, so attach to what is right and tend it with gentle care.

name: Influence
essence: Two forces are drawn to each other and respond. True influence comes from openness and stillness, not pressure, and it is the basis of attraction, friendship and partnership.

name: Duration
essence: What lasts is not rigid but self-renewing, like the cycle of the seasons. Duration means holding a steady direction through change, keeping to your course and your commitments.

name: Retreat
essence: A force you cannot stop is on the rise, and the wise move is to step back in good order. Retreat here is not defeat. It is how you keep your strength intact for a better day.

name: Great Power
essence: Your strength is high and rising. The test is not whether you have power but whether you use it rightly, with restraint and in line with what is fair.

name: Progress
essence: Like the sun climbing over the earth, things are moving upward easily and you are being seen. Progress comes from bright, generous conduct and from serving something larger.

name: Darkening of the Light
essence: The light has gone down into the earth: you are in a time when the unjust prevail and goodness is wounded. Keep your light hidden and burning within, and endure without giving up your principles.

name: The Family
essence: Every person and every group needs a home ground where roles are clear and care is real. When the inner circle is in order, its influence spreads outward.

name: Opposition
essence: People or forces are pulling in opposite directions. Large shared undertakings are not possible now, but small things can still go well, and differences can even become fruitful.

name: Obstruction
essence: The way ahead is blocked: danger before you, a steep mountain behind. Pushing forward is not the answer. Stop, turn inward, gather allies, and find the open way around.

name: Deliverance
essence: The storm breaks and the tension is released. Now the work is to clear away what remains of the trouble quickly, forgive, and return to an ordinary, easy life.

name: Decrease
essence: Something has to be reduced: spending, ambition, ego, excess. Done honestly and for the right reason, giving up is not loss but a deeper kind of wealth.

name: Increase
essence: A time of gain, when what flows down from above enriches those below. Use the momentum to act boldly, help others, and become better yourself.

name: Breakthrough
essence: One last negative element remains, and the time has come to remove it. Do it openly and resolutely, but without violence or arrogance.

name: Coming to Meet
essence: An unexpected meeting with a force that seems small but can quickly take over. Recognize it early, keep it in its place, and do not give yourself to it.

name: Gathering Together
essence: People are coming together around a common center. For a gathering to hold, it needs a worthy leader, sincere hearts, shared ritual and readiness for the unexpected.

name: Pushing Upward
essence: Like a tree rising from the earth, you grow upward through steady, patient effort. Success is achievable. Keep going and seek the right help.

name: Exhaustion
essence: You are trapped, drained or not believed. Outward means fail, but inner steadiness can turn the trial into success.

name: The Well
essence: The well is the unchanging source that nourishes everyone. Keep it clean, reach all the way down, and do not let your vessel break.

name: Revolution
essence: Something old has to be shed and replaced, the way an animal molts its coat. Change of this size succeeds only when its time has truly come and people can see why it is needed.

name: The Cauldron
essence: The sacred bronze cauldron cooks food for the community and offerings for the ancestors. It stands for what nourishes people at a deeper level. It also stands for setting yourself rightly in your place, so that a higher purpose can work through you.

name: The Arousing
essence: A sudden shock jolts you awake. Fear is natural, but if you keep your center and learn from it, the alarm turns into relief and even laughter.

name: Keeping Still
essence: Stop. Bring body and mind to rest, as still as a mountain. Then you act only when it is time to act, and rest when it is time to rest.

name: Development
essence: Lasting growth comes step by step, like a tree on a mountain or wild geese moving in stages toward the heights. Follow the proper sequence and don’t skip ahead.

name: The Marrying Maiden
essence: You are entering a relationship or situation on unequal terms, moved more by desire than by proper arrangement. You cannot set the rules here. What helps is tact, modesty and an eye on how it will end.

name: Abundance
essence: You are at a high point: full, bright, and powerful. Make the most of it like the sun at noon, without sorrow, knowing that every peak is followed by decline.

name: The Wanderer
essence: You are a traveler, a stranger in an unfamiliar place, without roots or standing. Move on gracefully: be modest and careful, keep to the right way, and do not overstay.

name: The Gentle
essence: Wind upon wind: influence that works by steady, quiet pressure rather than force. You get through by staying with something long enough, in a clear direction, until it gives way.

name: The Joyous
essence: Lake upon lake: shared, open joy that refreshes everyone it touches. Real gladness rests on inner firmness and honesty. Joy that is only seeking pleasure goes astray.

name: Dispersion
essence: Wind blowing over water breaks up ice and scatters mist. What is frozen, divided or blocked can be dissolved, and what has scattered can be gathered again around something shared and sacred.

name: Limitation
essence: A lake can hold only so much water. Healthy limits give life shape and strength, but limits that become harsh and bitter cannot last.

name: Inner Truth
essence: Wind over the lake, stirring the water to its depths. Sincerity so real that it reaches even the least receptive creatures, and moves the world from within.

name: Small Exceeding
essence: Thunder on the mountain: a time when only small things can be done. Go a little beyond the usual in care, humility and thrift, not in ambition. The bird should not fly high.

name: After Completion
essence: Water above fire: everything is in its place, the crossing is done. But order is at its most fragile just after it is achieved, so steady watchfulness is needed to keep it.

name: Before Completion
essence: Fire above water: everything is out of place, but the possibility of order is present. You are nearly across, so take great care in the final stretch.
